cases.name: the credit pattern stops requiring a date, so any .md counts
caught_by: a strike naming a non-entry Markdown file credits nobody: problems: wanted 0, got 1 ['a.md: `It does not do the first thing.` is closed, and the strike beside it credits correctness.md — which its `by` does not name. Describing the work is not citing it: a reader of the tracker has no way back to the entry that did it.']
